verdict.rationale: Kit's V4 API documents per-broadcast stats (recipients, opens, clicks, unsubscribes, rates, status) and per-link click performance, so campaign metrics can be pulled into a warehouse or dashboard, and cursor-based pagination and webhooks support ongoing syncs. Nothing in the evidence shows performance metrics for flows, meaning sequences or visual automations, so half the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: sequence/automation (flow) performance endpoints, account-level or bulk/time-series reporting export, independent or hands-on corroboration.
